summary: Implementation notes created for JPS Boarding Pass feature. Queueable-based async callout after registration, Account field storage, WebDB sync to Umbraco. 6 resolved questions, 7 open items.
output: Design completed. Key decisions: (1) Queueable instead of @future for async JPS callout, (2) Fire at registration (step 1) for guaranteed availability before profile access, (3) New Campaign Mechanic M29 for campaign identification, (4) Account.BoardingPassURL__pc for storage, (5) WebDB sync to Umbraco for profile page retrieval. Components: 1 new Apex class + test, 1 new Account field, 1 new picklist value, 1 Named Credential, 1 HTTPCalloutConfiguration__mdt, 2 modified registration classes.
